messages:
Maria (CS): Quick sync on Vectra week1 onboarding — putting a short watchlist and owners. High-level blockers: network peering delayed, KMS grant flow needs confirmation, IAM role missing kms:Decrypt for inference runner, audit logs not flowing to customer SIEM. Please ACK and tag owners.

Aarav Jenkins: ACK. I can pick up network peering. Need their spoke CIDR and our peer ASN. Do we have their AWS account IDs?

Devin - Platform Eng: I'll take the KMS grant flow. Can someone paste the current key policy or confirm they want a grant-based approach? If grant-based, we need the grant principal (role ARN). Example grant snippet I usually propose:
```
AWS::KMS::Grant:
  KeyId: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01
  GranteePrincipal: arn:aws:iam::987654321000:role/Vectra-Inference-Role
  Operations: ["Encrypt","Decrypt"]
```

Sam Reilly: Audit logs — they're advertising a Splunk HEC endpoint, but our ingestion only shows CloudTrail -> S3 so far. I'll re-run the collector test and post results.

Lee Zhang: FYI renewal risk: procurement mentioned potential push if go-live slips past this sprint. If we miss EOW, request could surface and delay renewal signoff. Suggest temporary hosted fallback for 2w as contingency (cost needs approval).

Aarav Jenkins: They provided account 987654321000 and CIDR 10.20.0.0/16. Starting the peering request now (creating route table entries + security-group review). ETA ~4h.

Devin - Platform Eng: Drafted grant in the internal ticket and linked policy examples. @Maria (CS) can you confirm customer wants grants (not CMK sharing)? Grants avoid cross-account key policies.

Maria (CS): They prefer grants. I'll confirm exact role ARN and post to ticket by EOD. Follow-ups: (1) Sam to validate logs by 15:00 PST, (2) Devin to finalize grants once role ARN posted, (3) Aarav to share peering acceptance proof. Short standup at 13:00 PT today. :thumbsup:

OpsBot: Reminder sent — standup for Vectra onboarding scheduled at 2026-03-21T13:00:00-07:00. :bell:

Sam Reilly: Quick update from collector test — missing CloudTrail S3 bucket policy. Failure excerpt:
```
403 AccessDenied: PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::redwood-vectra-cloudtrail failed
```
I asked them to add the bucket policy for the collection role and will re-run after.

Lee Zhang: Added mitigation note to renewal tracker (temporary hosted fallback). Lowers immediate renewal risk if privnet slips. :white_check_mark:

Maria (CS): Solid. Closing this watchlist for now; I'll post standup minutes after the call. If anything becomes blocking before then, ping here or @me. :eyes:
